title: I-131 — Application for Travel Document (Advance Parole)

sections.contato_assinatura: Part 10 — Applicant's Contact Information and Signature
sections.preparador: Part 12 — Preparer (if someone filled this out for you)

i131_confirma_i485.label: Is this Advance Parole (travel authorization) request based on a pending Form I-485 (Adjustment of Status)?
i131_confirma_i485.hint: This tool covers specifically this scenario (the most common one for the Green Card AOS package). If your Advance Parole is for a different reason (current parolee, TPS, pending asylum, CNMI, etc.), talk to our team -- those other reasons aren't automated here.

i131_recibo_i485.label: Your Form I-485 receipt number (if filing the I-131 separately from the I-485)
i131_recibo_i485.hint: Leave blank if filing the I-131 together (concurrent filing) with the I-485.

endereco_correspondencia_cuidado_de.label: Mailing address — In Care Of Name (if any)
endereco_correspondencia_cuidado_de.hint: Only fill this in if your mail is delivered care of another person (e.g. a friend, relative, or attorney) — enter their name. If mail comes straight to you, leave blank.

endereco_correspondencia_rua.label: Mailing address — Street number and name

endereco_correspondencia_codigo_postal_i.label: Mailing address — Postal code (outside the U.S.)

endereco_fisico_cuidado_de.label: Current physical address (if different from mailing) — In Care Of Name
endereco_fisico_cuidado_de.hint: Only fill this in if you live at this physical address care of another person (e.g. a friend, relative, or attorney whose home this is, who receives mail there on your behalf) — enter their name. If you live at this address under your own name, leave this blank.

endereco_fisico_rua.label: Current physical address — Street number and name

endereco_fisico_cidade.label: Current physical address — City or town

endereco_fisico_codigo_postal_intl.label: Current physical address — Postal code (outside the U.S.)

endereco_fisico_provincia.label: Current physical address — Province/State (outside the U.S.)

numero_a.label: Alien Registration Number (A-Number, if any)
numero_a.hint: Format A-XXXXXXXXX. Leave blank if you've never received one.

uscis_online_account.label: Your USCIS online account number (if any)
uscis_online_account.hint: 12 digits, no dashes. This is your myaccount.uscis.gov account number, not a case receipt number. Leave blank if you've never created that account.

classe_admissao.label: Current class of admission (if any)
classe_admissao.hint: The status code you were last admitted to the U.S. under (e.g. B2, F1) — check your Form I-94.

numero_i94.label: Your most recent Form I-94 number (if any)
numero_i94.hint: Look up or download your I-94 at i94.cbp.dhs.gov — the official record of your U.S. entry. 11 digits.

data_expiracao_i94.label: Expiration date of your authorized stay on your I-94 (if any)
data_expiracao_i94.hint: The date until which you're authorized to stay in the U.S. under your current status — also on i94.cbp.dhs.gov. If you have a pending adjustment of status (I-485), this date may already have passed; that's usually not a problem for Advance Parole, but confirm with our team.

etnia.label: Ethnicity
etnia.hint: An official U.S. government category, separate from "race" (next question) — this only asks whether you identify as Hispanic/Latino (Spanish or Latin American cultural/linguistic origin), regardless of race. Most non-Hispanic Brazilians select "Not Hispanic or Latino" here.

raca_havaiano_pacifico.label: Race: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

raca_indigena_americano.label: Race: American Indian or Alaska Native

historico_processo_remocao.label: Have you (or the person who will receive the document) ever been in exclusion, deportation, removal, or rescission proceedings?
historico_processo_remocao.hint: "Removal proceedings" is the immigration court process that can end in deportation — different from simply being out of status. Answer "Yes" if you were ever issued a Notice to Appear (NTA) or had a hearing, even if the case was later closed or you won. If unsure, answer "Yes" and confirm with our team before submitting — this can affect your eligibility.

historico_reentry_refugee_emitido.label: Have you ever been issued a Reentry Permit or Refugee Travel Document before?
historico_reentry_refugee_emitido.hint: A Reentry Permit and a Refugee Travel Document are OTHER types of travel document, different from the Advance Parole you're applying for now. This question is about your history — answer "Yes" only if you've specifically had one of these two documents before (not Advance Parole, asked next).

historico_reentry_refugee_situacao.label: Current status of that document (attached, lost, stolen, damaged/destroyed, still in your possession, etc.)

historico_advance_parole_emitido.label: Have you ever been issued an Advance Parole Document before?
historico_advance_parole_emitido.hint: Answer "Yes" if you've had an Advance Parole approved in any prior application (even from a different case) — don't confuse this with your I-94 or visa.

historico_advance_parole_data.label: Date that Advance Parole was issued

historico_advance_parole_situacao.label: Current status of that Advance Parole (attached, lost, stolen, damaged/destroyed, still in your possession, etc.)

historico_solicitando_substituicao.label: Are you requesting a replacement Reentry Permit, Refugee Travel Document, Advance Parole Document, or TPS Travel Authorization Document?
historico_solicitando_substituicao.hint: If yes, talk to our team for the specific replacement details — this tool covers the initial Advance Parole request, not the full replacement flow.

viagem_proposito.label: Purpose of the trip
viagem_proposito.hint: Briefly explain the reason for the trip (e.g. visiting family, business, tourism).

viagem_quantidade_viagens.label: How many trips do you intend to use this document for?
viagem_quantidade_viagens.hint: "One trip" authorizes a single exit and return; once used, the document becomes invalid even if the printed expiration date hasn't passed yet. "More than one trip" lets you leave and return as many times as needed while the document is valid. If you're not sure how many times you'll travel, multiple trips is usually the safer choice.

viagem_duracao_esperada.label: Expected length of the trip (in days)

interprete_idioma.label: Language the interpreter is fluent in (besides English)
